import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    
    ans = 0
    chars = list(s)
    n = len(chars)
    
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        current = chars[i]
        count = 0
        j = i
        while j < n and chars[j] == current:
            count += 1
            j += 1
        if count % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1
        i = j
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
